subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine capabilities, status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway and ContextEngine plugin API after the session-targeting blocker is fixed?
rationale: The PR adds a new public operator/admin Gateway endpoint and an optional plugin contract; that API boundary is a maintainer product decision beyond the mechanical session canonicalization fix.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read-only control
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and defer admin rotate until maintainers are comfortable with mutation semantics.

options.title: Defer the core API
options.body: Pause or close this core PR if context-engine maintenance control should remain plugin/private until a broader Gateway control contract exists.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed scope/docs semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history points to steipete for the session canonicalization and Gateway policy files that define the boundary this decision affects.
